items.title: Can Splitit Partnership Strengthen FIS' Issuer Processing Growth?
items.why: Installment-at-checkout through issuer processors is a possible route to add pay-over-time features to our cards without building it ourselves.
items.summary_ai: A Splitit partnership with FIS is raising questions about whether it can grow FIS issuer processing revenue.
items.take: Installment-at-checkout through issuer processors is a possible route to add pay-over-time features to our cards without building it ourselves.
